00034| -- Function to check if trial is expired and update status
00035| CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION check_and_expire_trial(user_id UUID)

00037| DECLARE
00038|   trial_expired BOOLEAN := FALSE;

00041|   UPDATE public.users 
00042|   SET 
00043|     is_trial_active = FALSE,
00044|     current_plan = 'FREE',
00045|     updated_at = NOW()
00046|   WHERE id = user_id 
00047|     AND is_trial_active = TRUE 
00048|     AND trial_expires_at < NOW()
00049|   RETURNING TRUE INTO trial_expired;

00051|   RETURN COALESCE(trial_expired, FALSE);
00052| END;
00053| $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

00055| -- Function to get user's trial status
00056| CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_trial_status(user_id UUID)

00058|   is_trial_active BOOLEAN,
00059|   trial_started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
00060|   trial_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
00061|   trial_plan TEXT,
00062|   has_used_trial BOOLEAN,

00066| BEGIN
